title: fanoutqa: Who is the oldest current serving member of the US Supreme Court? (a3efebf047c6d6ec)

chat_history.content: Who is the oldest current serving member of the US Supreme Court?

content.content: We need to answer: oldest current serving member of US Supreme Court. Likely Justice Clarence Thomas (born June 23 1948) or Justice Samuel Alito (born April 1 1950). Actually oldest is Justice Clarence Thomas (born 1948). There's also Justice Sonia Sotomayor (born 1954). So answer: Justice Clarence Thomas. Provide context.

content:
The oldest currently‑serving Justice on the United States Supreme Court is **Justice Clarence Thomas**.  

- **Date of birth:** June 23 1948  
- **Age (as of 2025):** 77 years old  

Justice Thomas was appointed by President George H. W. Bush and has been on the Court since October 23 1991, making him not only the senior‑by‑age member but also one of the longest‑serving justices in recent history.
